programs.title: Deep Dive Australia
programs.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward

programs.title: Deep Dive Australia
programs.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward

programs.title: Deep Dive Australia
programs.desc: Complete the trip’s final lap in the untamed lands where Australia’s interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward

programs.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist
programs.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summer’s soundtrack or go silent forever.

director: Producers: Elizabeth Trojian, Julia Nunes, Director: Julia Nunes

programs.title: Wild Crusades
programs.desc: The forests of Yala National Park are home to the enigmatic sloth bear. Shy by nature, this animal is seldom seen and rarely filmed. Join a team of wildlife filmmakers as they reveal this mysterious bear’s life and behaviour as never seen before.

programs.title: Wild Crusades
programs.desc: There’s a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.
